stem.text: Four students have drawn and labelled part of a structure seen on an electron micrograph.
Which student has labelled their drawing correctly?

A.alt: Line drawing of sieve tube elements with labels mitochondria, sieve plate and thin cytoplasm

B.alt: Line drawing of sieve tube elements with labels vacuole, mitochondria and sieve plate

C.alt: Line drawing of sieve tube elements with labels nucleus, sieve plate and thin cytoplasm

D.alt: Line drawing of sieve tube elements with labels chloroplast, sieve plate and thin cytoplasm
